primary_source.title: Generalised Kato classes on CM elliptic curves of rank 2
selectors: p.3: lambda_0 infinity type (-1,0), lambda_1/lambda_2 finite order
pp.4-5: psi_E is the Hecke character of E with L(E,s)=L(psi_E,s), and equation (1.5) expresses psi_E via lambda_0 times finite-order characters
p.5 Theorem B: generalized-Kato nonvanishing / Selmer dimension / res_p directions
p.6 Theorem C and proof: p-adic order hypotheses and derived elliptic-unit basis
p.6 Remark 1.3.1: p-adic BSD prediction and height/nondegeneracy equality caveats
p.7 Theorem 2.1.1: Katz interpolation for infinity types (k+j,-j), k>=1, j>=0

dimension_gate.input: Theorem B setup plus ord_{s=1} L_p(s)=2
dimension_gate.proof_direction: Theorem C proof gives r=dim_Qp Sel(Q,V_pE)<=2 from Rubin's CM Iwasawa main conjecture/Perrin-Riou and r>=2 from Coates-Wiles plus p-parity, hence r=2.

transverse_localization_gate.input: after r=2, Theorem C additionally assumes finite Sha(E/Q)[p^infinity] and ord_{s=1} L_p^*(s)=1
transverse_localization_gate.output: Rubin's derived elliptic unit x_p^(2) has res_p(x_p^(2)) != 0; together with Theorem B this gives the displayed two-dimensional basis

coordinate_axis_audit.complex_axis: L(E,s)=L(psi_E,s) varies the complex L-function argument s near 1.
coordinate_axis_audit.katz_axis: L_p(s)=mathcal{L}_p(psi_E <psi_E>^{s-1}) is a one-variable p-adic character specialization.
coordinate_axis_audit.interpolation_region: Theorem 2.1.1 states interpolation for Hecke characters of infinity type (k+j,-j) with k>=1 and j>=0.
coordinate_axis_audit.psi_E_infinity_type_reason: lambda_0 has infinity type (-1,0); lambda_1, lambda_2 are finite order; equation (1.5) expresses psi_E as lambda_0 times finite-order conjugate characters, so psi_E has infinity type (-1,0).
coordinate_axis_audit.consequence: psi_E itself is outside the displayed critical interpolation region, and the interpolation formula does not state a derivative/order-preservation theorem comparing ord_{complex,s=1} L(E,s) with ord_{p-adic,s=1} L_p(s) or L_p^*(s).
coordinate_axis_audit.authority_boundary: This is a source/interface route-pruning statement only, not a theorem that no such comparison can exist.

difference_witness.abstract_model: F_m(X,Y)=X^2+Y^m has order 2 on the Y=0 axis and order m on the X=0 axis.
difference_witness.use: Falsifies the structural shortcut 'shared ambient function/object name implies equal vanishing order on distinct axes' without an order-preserving transition witness.
difference_witness.disanalogy: This formal two-axis germ is not a model of complex or Katz p-adic L-functions and carries no arithmetic authority; it only tests the routing inference.
